meta.name: caveman-commit
meta.description: Write a Conventional Commits message compressed to intent only. Use for "write a commit", "commit message", /commit or /caveman-commit.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 浓缩代码改动为一句提交信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为提交信息措辞犯难,希望留下清晰记录。
copy.tagline_en: Condense code changes into one commit message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often struggle with commit messages and want clean history.

howto.what: 装上后它不会执行提交;请它写提交信息时,它会输出一段可复制粘贴的短说明:先写改动类型(feat=新功能、fix=修复),再写一句“添加/修复”式短句。默认不加 emoji 或 AI 署名;需要解释原因或属于破坏性改动时才附详细说明。
howto.when: 当你说“write a commit”或“commit message”,或输入 /caveman-commit 这类命令时触发。

say.text: 把刚才的改动写成一个 commit message
say.note: 直接生成可粘贴的提交信息。

say.text: 这次改动是破坏性的,提交信息里写清楚
say.note: 自动补上 BREAKING CHANGE 声明。

say.text: 写提交信息,说明代码为什么要这么改
say.note: 把“为什么”写进说明部分。

howto.what_en: When asked, it returns a paste-ready Conventional Commits block: type like feat/fix + short verb phrase, no emoji/AI credit by default. A body appears only for non-obvious reasons or breaking changes. It never stages, commits, or amends.
howto.when_en: Activates when you say “write a commit” or “commit message”, or type a slash command like /caveman-commit. It only writes the message; it never runs git commit.

say_en.text: Write a commit message for the change I just made.
say_en.note: Returns a paste-ready Conventional Commits message.

say_en.text: This change is breaking; write the commit message.
say_en.note: Adds a BREAKING CHANGE section automatically.

say_en.text: Write the commit message and explain why.
say_en.note: Puts the why in the body.
